expectations.text: Clearly recommends writing a performance test (answer is yes)
expectations.evidence: 'yes, this is a good candidate for a performance test'

expectations.text: Mentions the MR list endpoint being high-traffic as a key reason
expectations.evidence: 'It's hot ... even a small per-request slowdown becomes a large aggregate load'

expectations.text: Recommends a specific tool: GPT or custom k6 (not CPT or Sitespeed)
expectations.evidence: Recommends GPT (k6-based) and QueryRecorder; does not push CPT/Sitespeed.

expectations.text: Gives a concrete threshold number or regression budget percentage
expectations.evidence: Discusses p95/p99 and query-count guards but gives no concrete regression budget number/percentage.

expectations.text: Identifies that a JOIN on a hot path can introduce N+1 or index issues under load
expectations.evidence: 'a multi-table join is where N+1s and missing indexes show up under load'

expectations.text: Does not suggest running tests against staging or production
expectations.evidence: Says 'a proper load test against staging/a perf environment' — names staging as an acceptable target (only later softens to 'coordinate before hitting shared staging').
